additional_design_diagnostics: expected trajectory-minimum C and lower-tail CVaR_0.2 on B_signed at p=.2 and .4
common_generator: phi: i mod4 quadrant plus uniform jitter[0,pi/2]; random permutation of context order; x=rho cosphi,y=rho sinphi; theta=(phi+pi+error) mod2pi
inclusion: retain every generated context; no rejection by safety, Q*, goal, ranking, model or boundary excursion
objective_warning: D changes the original StressDream safety objective. Goal is external evaluation metadata, not drawn into WM images or supplied as a new WM control channel.
selection_rule: first in listed order satisfying design gate; no learned-model information
test_success_rule: same fractional informative threshold, >=3 singleton-optimal IDs each >=4/64, best-constant mean regret>.01, >=4 mixed safety contexts, no physical boundary excursion
